title: buy_stamp input
description: §6.3 — buy_stamp(count, payment, holder) -> StampReceipt. P-13: no field here carries private-key material, and none ever will; the buyer signs in its own process (§14.2).

payment.description: §14.2's two legs. The method must be one the Postmaster publishes on its price topic, or STAMP_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED.

network.description: CAIP-2, as the price list names it.

signedTransaction.description: The buyer's signature over the purchase body, base64. The Postmaster MUST NOT submit a purchase transaction without it (§14.2, T-P13-3).

holder.description: §6.3: {account} | {publicKey}. A public key with no account is the leg P-16 names - the transfer creates the account that holds the stamps (§4.6).

publicKey.description: The buyer's PUBLIC half. Never a private key (P-13).
